title: Vagaja2023: Motor-imagery EEG during embodiment-primed MI-BCI training in VR
description: EEG recordings from 26 healthy volunteers performing cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery during MI-BCI training in immersive virtual reality. Participants were randomized to an embodiment-primed (virtual hand illusion) group or a non-embodied control group, each completing one run of 40 trials. The dataset also includes bipolar EMG, skin temperature and accelerometry, and is a BIDS re-release of the Zenodo deposit produced via MOABB.
methods_description: 32-channel EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a Brain Products LiveAmp 32 and actiCAP active Ag/AgCl electrodes (10-20 montage), plus 2 EMG and 4 auxiliary channels. Each subject had one session with a single motor imagery run of 40 trials (20 per class), using a 10 s imagery/feedback window with visual cues in VR.
